rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a teacher or instructor.

example.english: This instructor teaches English very clearly.
example.traditional: 呢位老師教英文教得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lou5 si1 gaau1 jing1 man4 gaau3 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Choose this for an instructor leading a course, programme, or organised training.

example.english: The instructor for this course is very patient.
example.traditional: 呢個課程嘅導師好有耐性。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 ge3 dou6 si1 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a tutor who gives private or after-school lessons.

example.english: My instructor tells me to do exercises every day.
example.traditional: 我個補習老師叫我每日做練習。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 bou2 zaap6 lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 lin6 zaap6
